segments.text: You have been doing Arthi wrong.
Most of us just wave the lamp round and round.
But in temples, the lamp follows a path with a number for each part.
Then seven round his whole body.
And the flame, ghee or camphor with an odd number of vicks.
In the skandh purana, shift hell's parvati, do the arthi and the puja becomes complete.
Tonight, let your child hold the lamp and count four, two, three, seven.
Many homes circle the face just once.
What does your family do? Comment one or three.
